scope: message-boundary cache integration; CPU verification only

findings.trigger: Verified final user message ends at prompt[:-1]; repeated warm hit equals this offset and no new prefill forward occurs
findings.impact: Final snapshot overwrote same cache key with assistant eviction priority, losing message priority despite correct token/state contents
findings.fix: Keep verified roles for already consumed offsets; choose verified final boundary role for final snapshot; changed-shape metric considers only unconsumed splits
findings.validation: Independent original reproduction cold/warm user==user; portable regression and 20 targeted tests pass

findings.trigger: Real-model validator completes with a false token/calibration check
findings.impact: Original process exit0 could be confused with passing validation if callers ignore report bools
findings.fix: Save validation_failed report in finally, then exit1; source independently inspected; real model still pending

reviewed_invariants: Only token offsets proven identical to real full request prefixes are admitted
All cache snapshots occur after actual consumed tokens and mx.eval of target plus draft states
Default and cache=false prefill shapes/writes retain prior behavior
Full hits always leave one input token, with exact earlier snapshot fallback for nontrimmable recurrent state
Target/draft cache identity and clone ownership preserve branch isolation
cache_type forwards into installed upstream category accounting instead of inventing unsupported eviction priorities
No dummy probe IDs reach model input/cache keys
Metrics label host intervals and logical bytes accurately
Native delegated generation bypasses the message chunker; opt-in is explicit, not silently enabled

upstream_observation.description: Installed MLX-LM PromptTrie search ignores a one-token shorter prefix (last_index>0); project inherits a safe cache miss, not invalid reuse
upstream_observation.disposition: Nonblocking upstream behavior; independent fallback test uses a two-token earlier prefix; no production change made

approval_scope: CPU correctness and source quality only; not approval for default enablement, speed claims or public performance comparison
